name: Catchpoint
description: The synthetic-monitoring agent of Catchpoint's internet performance monitoring platform. Its HTTP and browser tests fetch customer-selected endpoints from Catchpoint's public and enterprise nodes on a schedule the customer sets, so the traffic is configured monitoring rather than crawling. The operator tells customers they may identify this traffic by a user agent containing "catchpoint", while warning that the header can be modified and varies by test type.
